# Callouts fixture

A lede paragraph so the document shell is well formed and the callouts below
each parse in isolation.

> [!NOTE]
> An informational note.

> [!TIP]
> A helpful tip.

> [!WARNING]
> A warning worth heeding.

> [!SECURITY]
> A security aside, shown or hidden by the lens.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Maps to the info tone with a nudge.

> [!CAUTION]
> Maps to the warn tone with a nudge.

> [!BOGUS]
> An unknown tone degrades to a plain quote and errors.

> A plain blockquote carries no tone.
